result.brief: 提出变分流匹配（VSF），在物理时间上学习条件潜分布以实现概率预测，可即插即用地增强 JEPA 世界模型的时序动态与规划成功率。
result.reason: Probabilistic flow-matching forecasting in physical time, integrated as plug-and-play predictor in JEPA world models for planning and manipulation; directly serves world modeling and long-horizon prediction.
